diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_launch_template.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.fargate is redundant — already implied by attribute references

The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng to :resource.aws_eks_cluster.cp duplicates the existing attribute-reference dependency (the ASG references the cluster in its tag configuration).

The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng to :resource.aws_launch_template.ng duplicates the existing attribute-reference dependency through the mixed instances launch-template specification.
The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng to :resource.aws_iam_role.ng duplicates the existing attribute-reference dependency through node_role_arn.
The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate to :resource.aws_iam_role.fargate duplicates the existing attribute-reference dependency through pod_execution_role_arn.

When SSM is enabled, the self-managed node instances install the SSM agent and require the SSM managed-instance policy to be attached before they launch. :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng does not currently depend on :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm-managed.

When SSM is enabled, the managed node instances install the SSM agent and require the SSM managed-instance policy to be attached before they launch. :resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng does not currently depend on :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm-managed.

The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng to :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is transitively established through :resource.aws_launch_template.ng and :resource.aws_iam_instance_profile.ng, which the ASG already depends on.

The explicit dependency from :resource.time_sleep.wait to :resource.aws_eks_cluster.cp is transitively established through :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng, which :resource.time_sleep.wait also explicitly depends on and which already depends on the cluster.
